descriptions.inProgress: In a courteous tone of voice, #p1102008# said he wanted to quiz you on your newly-gained knowledge to make sure that you learned the necessary basics of Maple World. When you completed the quiz, #p1102008# gave you a #t4032269# and asked you to report to #bEmpress #p1101000##k.
descriptions.completed: You went to see Empress #p1101000#, and the pale and fragile Empress welcomed you with a warm smile.
